The '''''Crimson Sword''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] in operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Like many such freighters, it was more than a simple transport craft.
